how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-scholomance-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4771:obj:0: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
rows.quest:4771:details:0: I've placed Dawn's Gambit in the container you brought to us, the one that held the dragon eggs. Your job is to bring it deep within the Scholomance.
rows.quest:4771:details:1: BThe undead mage Vectus leads a team of scourge scholars... place Dawn's Gambit in their chamber, called the "viewing room." It will then react with the undead found there and, with a little luck, destroy them!
rows.quest:4771:details:2: BAfter that, defeating Vectus shouldn't be a problem. Right?
rows.quest:4771:completion:0: You did it! Vectus is defeated! And Dawn's Gambit... did it work?
rows.quest:4771:completion:1: BHm... maybe my device wasn't the success I had hoped, but I'm glad you were able to handle things anyway. Well done, ⟦1⟧!
rows.quest:4771:completion:2: BThe Argent Dawn, and the good people of ⟦E1⟧, are in your debt.
rows.quest:5341:obj:0: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the ⟦E2⟧ fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to ⟦E3⟧; The Deed to ⟦E4⟧; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to ⟦E5⟧. Return to Alexi ⟦E6⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:5341:details:0: Within the Scholomance lays the ⟦E2⟧ fortune. I, Alexi ⟦E6⟧, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house ⟦E6⟧. My brother, Weldon, is the other.
rows.quest:5341:details:1: BWeldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.
rows.quest:5341:details:2: BHe now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!
rows.quest:5341:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦2⟧. Now to secure my inheritance...
rows.quest:5343:obj:0: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the ⟦E2⟧ fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to ⟦E3⟧; The Deed to ⟦E4⟧; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to ⟦E5⟧. Return to Weldon ⟦E6⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:5343:details:0: My dear brother Alexi. What a fool I was to spare his life. I looked into the face of the enemy, one of the undead, and let him live.
rows.quest:5343:details:2: BHe now searches for MY inheritance. This simply cannot happen.
rows.quest:5343:details:3: BFind my family's deeds before that vile retch gets his boney hands upon them and I shall reward you with vast riches. They lay in the ruins of the Scholomance. Make haste!
rows.quest:5343:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦4⟧. Now to secure my inheritance...
rows.quest:5382:obj:0: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.⟦5⟧
rows.quest:5382:details:0: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.
rows.quest:5382:details:1: BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:5382:completion:0: I can feel my spirit healing, ⟦7⟧. You have done my husband and I a great service, but I am certain there is more to be done.
rows.quest:5384:obj:0: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
rows.quest:5384:obj:1: BFight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:5384:details:1: B<Eva points to the vial inside the bag.>
rows.quest:5384:details:2: BThe blood of innocents. The purest blood, used to appease Krastinov's master.
rows.quest:5384:details:3: BIt is with this blood that Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with this blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.
rows.quest:5384:details:4: BTake the blood to the porch. Place it upon the brazier. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.
rows.quest:5384:details:5: BShould you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.
rows.quest:5384:completion:0: With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of Scholomance comes to a close. There is, however, more to be done. Others here are now aware of your brave acts. Take this, ⟦10⟧. It is a piece of our own essence. It will allow you to communicate with the other lost souls of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5466:obj:0: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
rows.quest:5466:details:0: There is but one task remaining, ⟦11⟧. Confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair.
rows.quest:5466:details:1: BUse the power of the keepsake against the beast - be unrelenting in your actions! Weather the blows that the flailing beast will surely bring down upon you. Do not give in to the pain!
rows.quest:5466:details:2: BWhen the ritual is complete, Ras will be mortal once more. It is at that point that he must be slain. Strike him down and take his human head.
rows.quest:5466:completion:0: Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, ⟦12⟧! You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.
rows.quest:5515:obj:0: Locate Jandice ⟦E6⟧ in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
rows.quest:5515:details:0: A great weight has been lifted from our hearts, ⟦13⟧, but your task is not yet complete. Krastinov's master, Kirtonos, still lives.
rows.quest:5515:details:1: BBefore you may face Kirtonos, however, you must first secure a method in which to summon him.
rows.quest:5515:details:2: BIt is said that Jandice ⟦E6⟧ stewards the blood of innocents from Krastinov to Kirtonos.
rows.quest:5515:details:3: BFind her in the sunken catacombs of Scholomance and strike her down. Bring back any clues that you may find.
rows.quest:5529:obj:0: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's ⟦E7⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:5529:details:0: The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight! We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across ⟦E1⟧ unchecked!
rows.quest:5529:details:1: BTheir necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.
rows.quest:5529:details:2: BGo to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... before they get any bigger!
rows.quest:5529:completion:0: Well done, ⟦14⟧! It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.
rows.quest:5529:completion:1: B...At least, I hope it will!
rows.quest:5531:obj:0: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
rows.quest:5531:details:0: The eggs you brought were to be used in Scourge experiments to create a plagued dragonflight. These frozen black dragon eggs would have been invaluable in their studies, and would have assuredly quickened their timetable.
rows.quest:5531:details:1: BNow, it is time we ended their research.
rows.quest:5531:details:2: BTake the frozen eggs to Betina Bigglezink outside. She is well-learned in science and alchemy, and has produced a weapon we can use against the Scourge. With your help, we will deal them a heavy blow.
rows.quest:5531:completion:0: There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!
rows.quest:5531:completion:1: BWe'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.
rows.quest:5531:completion:2: BI have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the Scholomance. They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.
rows.quest:5531:completion:3: BI call the device Dawn's Gambit, because... I'm not sure if it works!
rows.quest:5531:completion:4: BWill you find out for us?
rows.quest:8969:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8969:details:0: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.
rows.quest:8969:details:1: BKormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
rows.quest:8969:details:2: BBut even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
rows.quest:8969:completion:0: Good work, ⟦15⟧! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. But, there is more work ahead of us.
rows.quest:8969:completion:1: BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8992:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8992:details:0: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning next.
rows.quest:8992:details:1: BKormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
rows.quest:8992:details:2: BBut even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
rows.quest:8992:completion:0: Good work, ⟦16⟧! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. And now we have the completed amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8992:completion:1: BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
